title: thalictrum minus proles collinum
intro: Thalictrum minus proles collinum, commonly known as Meadow Rue, is a perennial plant species native to Europe and Western Asia. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its ability to stimulate digestion, reduce fever, and alleviate respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of Meadow Rue include flavonoids, saponins, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
